_purpose: Verbatim hook payloads captured from the live Cursor harness on 2026-09-18 (Cursor 3.17.8, workspace p:/doc_repo) by a temporary diagnostic registered in .cursor/hooks.json. These are records, not schemas: they exist so .cursor/hooks/normalize-payload.mjs is written against what the harness actually sends. Redacting them would weaken the instrument, so they are kept faithful, including the harness metadata fields the fleet does not use.
_capturedBy: A temporary diagnostic registered in .cursor/hooks.json for one capture run on 2026-09-18 (Cursor 3.17.8). It was removed immediately after; the payloads below are that run's capture, transcribed here so the record is tracked rather than left in ignored _scratch/.
_findings: beforeShellExecution carries the command at TOP LEVEL as `command`, not under tool_input. This is why .claude/hooks/_git-repo-target.ps1 returned an empty command for a Cursor payload and every PowerShell gate would have silently exited open if the Claude registrations had been copied across unchanged.

beforeShellExecution sends `cwd` as an EMPTY STRING. A hook deriving its worktree from payload.cwd gets nothing. workspace_roots[0] is the independently sourced substitute, sent as `/p:/doc_repo` with a leading slash and a colon, which scripts/enforcement/seat-register.mjs normalizePath does NOT handle (its `/x/...` rule yields `p::/doc_repo`).

preToolUse for both the Write tool and the StrReplace tool arrives with tool_name "Write" and tool_input {file_path, content}. The resulting full file content is in `content`, singular; there is no `contents` key.

preToolUse for the sub-agent launch tool arrives with tool_name "Task", not "Agent", and tool_input {description, prompt, subagent_type, run_in_background}. Both canon-gate.ps1 and dispatch-template-gate.ps1 gate on toolName -eq 'Agent', so a Task payload falls through their `-notin @('Agent','Write')` exit-open check.
beforeReadFile DOES fire, and its payload carries file_path and the file's full `content`. A matcher of "Read" does NOT fire it; registered with no matcher it fires on a Read tool call.
beforeReadFile carries no tool_name field, so canon-divergence-run.ps1's `tool_name -ne 'Read'` guard exits open on a raw Cursor read payload.

claudeArrayForm._note: Claude Code PreToolUse for a sub-agent. Kept for the normalizer's array-shape branch; this shape is documented in canon-gate.ps1's header, verified 2026-08-08, and is not a Cursor capture.

tool_input.content: scratch probe for hook payload capture

tool_input.prompt: Do not read, search, or list any files. Reply with exactly the four characters: ok.
